review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–276). It contains only theorems: lps_slab_ae_slice, lps_slab_integral_mul_congr, lps_l2_time_curve_ae, lps_gradient_time_curve_ae and lps_strong_time_regularity. It has no definitions, structures, abbreviations or instances, so it introduces no concept that could compete with a Mathlib one. The concepts it uses all come from outside the file: MemLp, Lp, Measure.restrict and memLp_pi_iff from Mathlib, and vlSlab, spaceTimeSet and HasSpaceTimeWeakDerivs from the project. The file reuses the Mathlib versions of the Mathlib ones. The slice lemma and the integral congruence lemma are small standalone theorems, and the rubric excludes theorem duplication and proof shortening. The repeated blocks of hweak', hgrad' and hhess' are proof repetition, not a competing concept. I did not check how vlSlab is defined, because it is outside this file.
